title.en: SDG 5: A Fair World for Everyone

narrative_brief:
任務：SDG 5 —— 性別平權演說大拼圖
Can you balance the world in 6 minutes and 40 seconds? The world is unfair, and your script is scrambled! Before you can deliver your powerful Pecha Kucha talk, you need to fix the "Equality Gap."
你能用 6 分 40 秒讓世界變得更公平嗎？世界充滿了不平等，而你的講稿卻亂成一團！在你發表震撼人心的 Pecha Kucha 演說之前，你需要先修復這道「平權裂痕」。

Step 1: Know Your Battle Plan (熟悉你的作戰計畫)
Every hero needs a map. To defeat gender bias, your speech must pass through these 6 Zones:
每個英雄都需要地圖。要打敗性別偏見，你的演說必須經過這 6 個關卡：
Part 1: The Hook (引言) Wake them up! (喚醒聽眾！)
Part 2: The Root Cause (問題根源) Old ideas! (舊觀念怪獸！) 
Part 3: The Reality Check (現實挑戰) The hard truth. (殘酷的真相。) =
Part 4: The Daily Life (日常實踐) Start at home! (從家裡開始！) 
Part 5: The Nerd Power (未來創新) Tech for all! (科技救平權！) 
Part 6: The Mic Drop (結語與行動) Be the change! (成為改變的力量！)

Step 2: The Logic Clue Search (邏輯線索大搜索)
Based on the Keywords, guess which "Zone" the script card belongs to.
根據關鍵字，猜猜這張演講片屬於哪個「關卡」。

Step 3: Level Up Your Brain (腦力大升級)
When the puzzle is finished, don't leave yet! Ask yourself:
拼圖完成後，先別急著走！問問自己：
✔ Why this piece? (為什麼是這片？)
✔ The Flow (流暢度): 講者如何從「嚴重的問題指認」轉向「重要的解決方案與行動」（第五關）而不讓聽眾感到沉重或分心？
